project_name: Franklin County abei Energy data center prospect
aliases: abei Energy Franklin County data center
status_detail: Local newspaper reported a Jan. 2026 introductory meeting organized by the economic development commission president; abei Energy described site prospecting for a Franklin County facility, with no LOI signed yet and feasibility/grid studies to follow if landowner options proceed.
notes: Article gives early project parameters: 200-600 acre search, 15 buildings, possible early-2030s operation, 10-20M gallon initial cooling fill, but no signed LOI. County planning page/search results show data-center moratorium workgroup and draft regulations permitting data centers as Class 3 conditional use in I-1.

status_detail: Potential 500 MW, 300-acre campus near Akron circulated in Jan.-Feb. 2026; no formal application had been filed when the Area Plan Commission recommended a moratorium. Commissioners approved a one-year moratorium on Mar. 2, 2026, effective immediately.
notes: Official Fulton County page confirms a Data Center Ordinance Committee and posted agendas/minutes. DCD identifies Decennial Group/David Pavlick and a 500 MW proposal; local TV confirms county moratorium and Akron-area sites being eyed.
